independentValidation.finding: The data workflow is correct online and offline, but RAYONS and the scalar path render after the product grid instead of as top navigation.

genericCorrection.problem: UpdateList kept object values at runtime but did not propagate their schema into an iterator, and a clear action could overwrite a richer schema for the same target.
genericCorrection.result: The live Run5 picker now exposes executable bindings for breadcrumb[0].name, breadcrumb[0].levelId and breadcrumb[0].sourceBreadcrumb after append and clear actions.
genericCorrection.run5Policy: Run5 was not rewritten after the fix, so it remains an honest fresh-agent benchmark.

remainingGaps.behavior: Run5 displays one RAYONS command and a scalar path after the grids; intermediate segments are not actionable.
remainingGaps.next: Use the corrected UpdateList schema picker in the next fresh run and place the breadcrumb before catalog content.

remainingGaps.behavior: Image.source has no directly executable literal candidate; the agent had to construct the standard literal binding for project fixture URLs.
